title: Create launch checklist, monitoring setup, and post-launch runbook
acceptance_criteria: Launch checklist created covering: DNS, SSL, CI/CD, health checks, backups, monitoring, alerts
Health check endpoint GET /api/health returns: { status, db, storage, version, uptime }
Basic monitoring: Docker container restart policy, UptimeRobot or similar heartbeat
Logging: container logs shipped to centralized location (journald or file)
Database backup cron job: pg_dump to DO Spaces weekly, with 30-day retention
Alert thresholds defined: 5xx rate > 1%, response time > 5s, disk usage > 80%
Post-launch monitoring runbook: how to check logs, restart services, rollback deployment
Incident response template created for security events and outages
